description: Base balance lookup: native ETH for an address, optionally plus one ERC-20 balance. When to use: a Base agent needs to know whether a wallet can pay gas, or how much of a token it holds. Data source: external Base JSON-RPC (no self-hosted Base node). Returns: native_balance_wei / native_balance_eth, current block, and for a token contract balance_raw / decimals / balance. Free: no metering.

contract.description: Optional ERC-20 contract to read balanceOf

name: base_get_balance
